fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Alerts to the stylist on the booking

An answer can trigger an email or a Slack message to the stylist who has the appointment. Clients who have not signed yet get a reminder email before they arrive at the salon.
fieldData.awb---key-feature-1-content:
One yes to a dye reaction puts a patch test first

Halden Street Salon asks every color client, in the chemical service section, whether they have ever reacted to hair dye. When Noor Haddad answered yes, stylist Rhea Tamsin got an email to book a patch test before the color appointment.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { colorServices: "Build a salon waiver form for color and chemical services. Ask each client whether they have ever reacted to hair dye, about scalp sensitivity, and about recent chemical treatments elsewhere. If a client answers yes to a past dye reaction, email the stylist on the booking to schedule a patch test before the color appointment.", frontDeskTablets: "Make a salon waiver that clients sign on a tablet at our front desk. Look up the client by name and phone. New clients sign and the waiver saves to their client record. If a returning client's waiver is more than 12 months old, show the waiver again and ask them to sign before their service.", nailBookings: "I run a nail salon that books gel and acrylic sets online. Create a waiver form for it. Send the waiver link with each booking confirmation. If a client has not signed 24 hours before the appointment, email them a reminder with the same link, and show signed or not signed next to each appointment.", clientRecords: "Set up a client waiver database for a hair salon. Save each signed waiver with the client's name, the service, the service date, the stylist, and every allergy answer. Let the owner search by client name and open any signed waiver from the results." };
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a salon waiver form that saves every response to a database I own.
